items.title: Tom Albert and Milton "Mooney" Martin Interview, 1964-12-21
items.q: Old Man Solace had that grocery there. ... That's old man Solace. That's right. He killed a... He was eleven years old and John was ten and he killed him.

ctx.x: Right across where Sigacy. Sigacy, yeah. Old Man Solace had that grocery there. Yeah, I don't know. The stables was right in the back of it.
